defects.description: Splitting records only on LF leaves the carriage return in the final field of CRLF records.
defects.why_missed: The suite imports only LF documents; identical branch execution with a different line-ending representation changes the field contents.

defects.description: Filtering falsy fields removes empty columns and shifts subsequent values into the wrong positions.
defects.why_missed: The happy suite uses populated columns, so the filtering callback runs without ever exercising an empty field.
